reviews.author: Bonny Bam
reviews.text:
An absolute gem in Srinagar! Waking up right in the middle of an apple orchard is a surreal experience and looks amazing on camera. The property is peaceful, well-maintained, and gives you that authentic Kashmiri vibe.

reviews.author: Shilpa Devgan
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at The Kabo Hotel, Kashmir, and it was truly a wonderful experience.
I travelled from New Zealand🇳🇿, and this was my first visit to the hotel. From the moment I arrived, I felt warmly welcomed and genuinely cared for. The hotel beautifully combines comfort, cleanliness, and exceptional hospitality.
The ambiance of the hotel is peaceful, relaxing, and visually stunning. The rooms were spotless, well-maintained, and very comfortable, making my stay extremely pleasant. The views from the hotel are absolutely beautiful.
I would like to sincerely thank the entire staff for their professionalism, politeness, and friendly nature. Everyone was always ready to assist with a smile.
A special thank you to Aurmela, Insha, and Akib for their outstanding service and kind support. Your warm and helpful attitude truly made my stay even more memorable.
I would also like to extend my appreciation to the Manager, Mr. Gowhar, for managing everything so efficiently and ensuring that guests feel valued and comfortable. His excellent leadership clearly reflects in the quality of service provided by the team.
Heartfelt thanks to the housekeeping department, especially Mr. Ishfaq, for maintaining exceptional cleanliness and keeping the room perfectly neat and comfortable throughout my stay. The attention to detail was truly impressive.
I would also like to thank the reception team and the staff member who warmly greeted us and opened the door each time. Although I do not know his name, his courteous behaviour and welcoming smile added a lovely touch to the overall experience.
Overall, my first experience at The Kabo Hotel, Kashmir was delightful and unforgettable. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for comfort, warmth, and outstanding service.
Thank you once again for such a beautiful stay. I look forward to visiting again.

reviews.author: Tabish Habib
reviews.text:
I had an extremely disturbing experience at The Vintage, Srinagar. I ordered a chicken dish, and the moment it arrived, the pieces looked visibly discoloured and unappetizing. This should have been the first red flag.

We raised concern immediately and even left most of it there. Every single person who consumed the food regardless of quantity fell severely ill within hours. What followed was not just discomfort, but acute food poisoning. The condition was so serious that we required IV treatment and medical supervision for the next three days.

This is not just poor quality it is a serious lapse in food safety and hygiene standards. Serving food in such condition is unacceptable and dangerous.

I strongly caution others to avoid this place until they address their kitchen practices and hygiene protocols. This experience was not only disappointing but genuinely hazardous to health

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Orchard Retreat & Spa, Srinagar, and it was truly a wonderful experience. From the moment I arrived, the property impressed me with its beautiful surroundings, peaceful atmosphere, and well-maintained open spaces. It’s the kind of place where you instantly feel relaxed and connected with nature.

What really made the stay special was the amazing service. The staff were incredibly courteous, attentive, and always ready to help with genuine warmth. Their hospitality made the entire experience feel very personal and comfortable.

The facilities are excellent — the open areas are perfect for unwinding, and the gym and sauna are clean, well-equipped, and thoughtfully maintained. It’s clear that a lot of care goes into keeping the property in great shape.

The food was another highlight of the stay — fresh, delicious, and prepared with great attention to taste and quality.

Overall, Orchard Retreat & Spa is a calm, beautiful, and well-managed property that offers a perfect blend of comfort, hospitality, and relaxation. I would happily recommend it to anyone visiting Srinagar who wants a peaceful and memorable stay.

reviews.text:
My stay at **Hotel Welcome Grand Srinagar** was truly memorable and filled with warmth. The hotel has a beautiful and peaceful ambience, but what really touched my heart was the incredible behaviour of the staff and management. They genuinely live up to the name **“Welcome”** — from the moment you arrive, you feel respected, valued, and cared for.

The restaurant experience was the highlight of our visit. The manager was such a gentle and humble host, and the entire team was extremely polite and attentive. Their kindness and hospitality made us feel less like guests and more like family.

And the food… absolutely outstanding. It was honestly **one of the best meals I have ever had in Kashmir**. Every dish was full of flavour and prepared with great care, making the dining experience truly unforgettable.

With such passionate management and such a respectful, hardworking team, I am sure this hotel will rise to **an even greater level very soon**. Wishing them all the success they deserve.
Muzamil owner of Kashmirani
